title: ComplaintResponse
description: A single complaint as returned by the Speak Ukrainian Complaint API. The `date` field is serialized by the API as a `[year, month, day]` integer array (the OpenAPI docs describe it as a `date` string, but the live backend emits an array — see news_response.json for the same pattern). Every nullable field uses `["string", "null"]` because the live backend emits `null` for unset values (for example `answerText` is null until someone answers, `urlLogo` is null for users without an avatar). `additionalProperties: true` keeps the contract permissive for nested `user` / `club` / `recipient` objects, which carry more fields than the strict OpenAPI shapes declare.
